description: Patch schema for local four-stem Hybrid Demucs separation through ComfyUI.

unmapped_ui_parameters.stem_split_model: The committed Comfy workflow uses Torchaudio HDEMUCS_HIGH_MUSDB_PLUS and produces bass, drums, other, and vocals. The old htdemucs_6s option is blocked until a certified Comfy six-stem graph exists.
unmapped_ui_parameters.stem_split_guitar: Guitar is included in the other stem for this Hybrid Demucs workflow.
unmapped_ui_parameters.stem_split_piano: Piano is included in the other stem for this Hybrid Demucs workflow.

output.contract: Return four audio artifacts keyed as bass, drums, other, and vocals with durations matching the source audio.
